text: Who benefits by the death of Prince Michael? We’ve got to answer that before we can get anywhere.” “The Revolutionary party of Herzoslovakia——” began George. Superintendent Battle waved him aside with something less than his usual respect. “It wasn’t the Comrades of the Red Hand, sir, if you’re thinking of them.” “But the paper—with the scarlet hand on it?” “Put there to suggest the obvious solution.” George’s dignity was a little ruffled. “Really, Battle, I don’t see how you can be so sure of that.” “Bless you, Mr. Lomax, we know all about the Comrades of the Red Hand.
